findings.problem: Exact-structure precheck prevented disclosed missing carry-source inspection, making required physical10/16 report unreachable
findings.correction: Only declared pinned carry source may be absent; wrong state or other missing placement still refused; full lamp inspection remains required

findings.problem: UNLOCK ownership checked before async prepare, leaving an inspection-start interleaving that could release a live checker lock
findings.correction: Inspection owner reserved on consume through report persistence; UNLOCK rechecks ownership before consume; checker start validates owner/lock/pending/revision/health

findings.problem: Armed input allowed right-click use-block changes to a repeater under BREAK or adjacent PLACE arm without consuming the exact native mutation permit
findings.correction: Match action/main hand/current healthy unexpired arm; BREAK left click only. PLACE uses default native interaction only on explicit safe reference materials; matched interactive references must refuse without property changes. This replaces invalid DENY/ALLOW placement approach.

findings.problem: An intermediate BREAK hardening set useItemInHand DENY, which pinned ServerPlayerGameMode immediately returns from before mining
findings.correction: Legitimate matched BREAK leaves item-use default; action restriction already denies right-click interactions

findings.problem: Port-relative geometry allowed all ports to be translated away from protected approved circuit
findings.correction: Port bounds and approved material checked; a0 anchor and carry source fixed to the supported approved origin

findings.problem: Native permission helper ignored quarantine and reversed authority time
findings.correction: activeActor observes clock and requires healthy unquarantined non-regressed state; fresh bootstrap/reconciliation preserved

findings.problem: Mixed use-interacted-block DENY/item ALLOW suppressed legitimate native placement and could be mistaken by the harness for a refusal
findings.correction: Explicit safe noninteractive reference whitelist with default vanilla use, plus real Survival placement positive control; denial classifier rejects mixed flags as proof of refusal

Journal receipts attest observed effect and restart mismatch quarantines. No custom asynchronous Minecraft writer recommended.
